_blocks.text: N17: Haunted Halls of Slaughter
“Civilization is a lie; let the beast awaken and chase the game!”
Revelations
A map in the office shows this property and how to operate the secret door.
Documents recovered elsewhere point to this property.
Overview
**City District.** “Craftsmen’s Quarter”, **Street Name.** “Miller’s Way”
The weathered stone structure rises three stories, its thick walls built to endure decades of heavy use.

_blocks.label: Purpose
_blocks.text: The PCs can investigate the hunting grounds and find clues about the past.

_blocks.label: History
_blocks.text: Prior to the current cult, the dungeon was occupied by the Cult of the Dragon.

_blocks.label: Secret Door
_blocks.text: A star-shaped anchor plate must be pulled and turned left; the door is counterbalanced and pushed inward to open.
Main Scenario
Haunted Halls Features

_blocks.label: Atmosphere
_blocks.text: The air feels cold and dank. An oppressive atmosphere weighs on the PCs.

_blocks.label: Lighting
_blocks.text: Sconces line the walls but hold no torches; the halls remain pitch black.

_blocks.label: Doors
_blocks.text: Sturdy wood reinforced with iron. Locks require a DC 15 check to open.
Random Encounters
Random encounters may occur if the PCs make excessive noise or move carelessly.
Adversary Roster

rows: Goes for the kill; leads PCs into the S7 trap

_blocks.text: Locations of The Haunted Halls of Slaughter (S)
The following locations are keyed to the map of the Haunted Halls (S).
S1: The Entrance
A steep flight of stairs made of yellowish stone blocks descends into the cold darkness.

_blocks.label: Metal plate and handle
_blocks.text: The mechanism used to open and close the secret door leading inward.
S2: Western Hallway
At the bottom of the stairs lie the remains of a humanoid clutching a shortsword.

_blocks.label: Denizens
_blocks.text: The corpse animates as a **skeleton** as soon as the PCs investigate it.

tiers.Frail: A **skeleton** rises to give you a bony grin.
tiers.Baseline: A **skeleton** with maximum hit points (20) rises to give you a bony grin.
tiers.Strong: A **skeleton** with maximum hit points (20) rises and a **zombie** shuffles in after one round.
tiers.Hard to kill: A **skeleton** with maximum hit points (20) rises and two **zombies** shuffle in after one round.

_blocks.label: Loot
_blocks.text: The PCs find 3 gp and 31 sp in a purse full of holes. The shortsword is rusty but usable.
Developments
The Curse or Blessing of Baphomet’s Influence
Transformation to a minotaur
The transformation did not happen willingly; the PC keeps a hazy memory of the group.
Clues
Evidence
Letters found in area S12 tie the site to outside agents.
Leads
An invitation points the PCs toward Ironwood Wizardry.
